evidence.text: The Meal Planning App Market was valued at USD 1.47 Billion in 2025 and is expected to reach USD 3.87 Billion by 2035, growing at a CAGR of 10.18%.

evidence.text: Thermal and compressed air storage cheaper than lithium-ion batteries for 8-plus hour durations: BNEF

evidence.title: Food Waste Statistics 2026 - Copia Resources
evidence.text: The average American spends more than $762 per year on food that ends up wasted.
